notes.title: Community Update 6: Featuring Community Mods
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We're excited to drop our latest Community Update video![/p][p]While our team is still hard at work on the next major content update (more on that below), we wanted to showcase already how the current tools are helping players make some super content.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="BBps9xp8huo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h3][b]Getting Started With Mods[/b][/h3][p]The community has already been hard at work, with [b]over 200 mods[/b] already available on the Steam Workshop! We are absolutely blown away by your creativity. If you're ready to customize your experience, getting started is simple:[/p][olist][*][p]Navigate to your [b]Steam Library[/b] and select Bellwright.[/p][/*][*][p]Click on the [b]“[url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1812450/workshop/"][u]Workshop[/u][/url]”[/b] tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Browse the amazing creations and click [b]“Subscribe”[/b] on any mod you want to try.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam will handle the rest! The mod will be automatically downloaded and added to your game.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Co-op Players:[/b] Remember that all players in a session will need to have the same mods subscribed and active to play together.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/590d84cc876b0101d5a1ef7be4c4b2ba035a4b24.jpg"][/img] [/p][h3][b]A Glimpse of What's Coming[/b][/h3][p]We couldn't leave you without a little something about the next big content update. We know you're all eager for it, and development is progressing well![/p][p]Stick around till the end of the video and you’ll see a sneak peek of our newest addition to functional/buildable walls with raiders able to break down the gate for entry. On top of that, there are some new gear pieces like the crossbow which are coming with the next update.

Keep in mind these are still being worked on and likely to change before the final product.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Join the Conversation & Share Your Feedback[/b][/h3][p]We can't wait to see the incredible mods you all create. It’s what will help Bellwright grow for years to come. For help, feedback, or to share your creations, be sure to:[/p][p][url="http://discord.gg/bellwright"][u][b]Join our Official Discord[/b][/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p]As always, Bellwright is in Early Access, and your feedback is vital. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please report them at [/p][p][url="https://playbellwright.com/support"]playbellwright.com/support[/url][/p][p] or on our discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Official Modding Support
notes.content:
[p]What happens when passionate players take a game, flip it on its head, and transform it into something the original developers never even anticipated? That's exactly how Donkey Crew was born 15 years ago—from a single experimental mod for Mount&Blade that spiraled into something much bigger. And now, here we are with Bellwright.[/p][p]
Today, we're inviting you to join us on this journey: Official modding support is here. Download the modkit and show us what [b][i]you [/i][/b]imagine Bellwright to be, because the most impressive and fun creations often come from someone looking at a game and asking "But what if...?" No more reverse-engineering required (though honestly, watching you all figure it out was pretty impressive).[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="71y7IRv4u7c;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]
What does that mean in practice?[/h2][p][/p][p]First of all - [url="https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=1812450&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems"]Steam Workshop[/url], where you can search for and subscribe to mods that you’d like to try. All subscribed to mods are enabled by default when you start the game, but can be disabled in the main menu or by unsubscribing.[/p][p][/p][p]Second, [url="https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/bellwright-modkit"]Bellwright ModKit[/url] is now available for everyone at [url="https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/bellwright-modkit"]Epic Games Store[/url]. Modkit is a custom version of Unreal Engine 5 editor that offers all the functionality our own devs use to create content for Bellwright, as well as a convenient way to package and upload your mods to the Workshop.[/p][p][/p][p]Simple changes like modifying or adding new items, structures and technologies are very simple and trivial, and don’t require any prior knowledge or experience. You can find some guides on how to do that on our [url="https://modding.playbellwright.com/"]modding wiki[/url] and, once you gain some experience, help other modders by writing your own.[/p][p][/p][p]Adding new features via visual scripting and other Unreal tools is a little more tricky, and may require some tinkering. Luckily it’s a popular engine and there are plenty of tutorials available online.[/p][p][/p][p]Last but not least, on our [url="https://discord.gg/bellwright"]official Discord[/url] we have new channels and forums for everyone interested in modding to ask questions, share knowledge and discuss anything related to it with other modders and developers. [/p][p][/p][p]Keep in mind that this is just the first public version of Modkit, and as we progress through Early Access and receive feedback - we will keep adding tools for modders to use. For any suggestions, requests, and complaints, feel free to use the Modkit Feedback tag in the modding forum on our discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Unfortunately, due to stricter regional rating agencies, at the moment Modkit can't be downloaded from EGS in several countries: Australia, Brazil, Germany, Russia and South Korea. We are aware of this limitation and working on resolving it.[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck to everyone giving it a try, we are looking forward to seeing what you guys come up with :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/2e4456f125ea746cb0f5071eb5dda28250a00e15.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Medieval survival game Bellwright is revived and transformed by giant new update
notes.content:
Bellwright has a fantastic central premise. Your medieval home country is being pillaged and ruined by a despotic king. By traveling between boroughs and settlements, you gradually raise a small militia, using them to capture patches of territory. Gather resources. Build houses. Forge an upstart economy. Over time, you unite your fledgling townships under a single banner and march on the evil empire - it's an RPG, survival game, and medieval strategy saga all in one. Manor Lords might have stolen the spotlight. Age of Empires has the historic RTS crown. But Bellwright remains one of Steam's best hidden gems, and now it's bigger and better thanks to a whirlwind anniversary update.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/366f721828ada7d8c46aee232f071962ffb4a525.jpg[/img]
[expand]Dear Lubomir,

Words can not express how proud you made us feel this year.

Watching you make your first steps… How curious you are about learning the world, and how tireless you are about making it better. You have a kind heart and at the same time you are always ready to fight to protect the people of Karvenia. On this day we want to make you a present, something you were asking for a long time - you can have a pet animal, but you will need to care about it and build a home for it (no, you can't bring your cow into the house).

Enjoy this happy moment, but keep your axe sharp, as safety is never permanent in these lands.

Your loving parents[/expand]
Hello everyone! 

As you have probably guessed from the letter above, today we are celebrating our anniversary - exactly 1 year ago Bellwright was released into early access. This year was neither easy nor boring. Through several major updates, multiple smaller ones and dozens of patches with bugfixes we resolved early stability and performance problems, added lots of important quality of life improvements, introduced new mechanics and overall improved the game in so many ways that it’s impossible to list all of them in a single post. 

And all of this would be impossible without you: your relentless support, feedback and suggestions, videos and streams, mods, discord discussions... All of this provides invaluable help in development and constant motivation for making the game better. Saying that we are happy about the game's community would be a severe understatement. Special shoutout to our preview players - thanks to your help most of the gamebreaking bugs never make it into the public build. 

Anniversaries are a time to look back, but also to keep moving forward. So what’s new in this Anniversary Update? By far the biggest addition is animal husbandry, bringing chickens, pigs and cows into your settlements. Whether you want just a few animals for your cozy homestead or you're planning to breed and trade livestock for profit, we hope that you’ll enjoy animal husbandry as much as we do.

Fishing, consistently one of your top feature requests ever since the Bellwright demo at Steam Next Fest in 2023, also makes its long-awaited debut, alongside traveling merchants, a library structure to automate book reading by your villagers, the ability to save squad rosters, and much more.

And as a special anniversary surprise… We’re excited to open signups for [b]Bellwright Modkit[/b] testing!

After a year of working on the game alongside you, we can't wait to see the new adventures that you'll bring to life on your own. The test will begin within a few weeks and spots are limited, so be sure to sign up soon and help shape the future of Bellwright modding!

[b]Sign up here:[/b] [url=https://playbellwright.com/modkit]https://playbellwright.com/modkit[/url]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[b]Notable Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Introduced animal husbandry – animals can now be purchased from special merchants in villages and points of interest, and housed in animal husbandry structures. With proper care and feeding, they will breed and produce resources such as eggs, feathers, milk, and, eventually, meat.
[*] Introduced fishing with a variety of mini-games to play, types of fishes to catch, and a Fishing Hut allowing villagers to fish as well.
[*] Added a Butchery and overhauled gathering resources from dead animals - carcasses can now be either skinned or picked up to later be processed by a butcher for better yield.
[*] Added a Library with book storage and reading priorities, allowing villagers to pick up and read books based on their assigned priorities automatically.
[*] Added an ability to save squad rosters for future use.

notes.title: Spring Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Spring is coming and with it, our latest update. We’ll be bringing many new features and Quality of Life improvements for you to experience. This update in particular includes some features that we’ve been wanting to add since stepping into early access. So let’s dive into what’s coming:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/8d7b4d9c0863444df16f60a9be4282dccab82159.jpg[/img]

[h2]Animal Husbandry & Improved Animals
[/h2]
Raise, care for, and obtain a variety of animals with the new Animal Husbandry system! This feature will bring even more depth to managing your settlements. You’ll find new vendors in nearby towns to start and can breed and harvest more as you raise them to adulthood. Plus, we’re enhancing wild animal behaviors and interactions to make them feel more lifelike as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/15e3b99a016b0e3c3fbd7c43f2131e5c71fbd2e6.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Butchering Interactions[/h2]
Alongside animal husbandry we're adding a new option to process animals even further with butchering and skinning. You’ll be able to acquire more meat and pelts by bringing the carcass back to your settlement and processing it down. The yield for this can be aided by the butchering bench as well as your hunting skill when used by you or your companions. This ensures that every part of the animal is put to good use when it comes to hunting in Karvenia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/f05f825c863599ee58a777f5fba0c8a2c2d04b34.jpg[/img]

[h2]Library & Sitting Behaviors[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/f2e419759abe6b185dcd77b8d3c1f12f1d1d7e78.jpg[/img]

Build this new structure to give your companions a space for reading the many books you’ve collected along the way. We felt it was important as you get into the latter half of the game to have a more automated process when it comes to training your companions. We’re adding some great settings to customize this feature to your liking and it should save you some tedium when it comes to management. Additionally, characters now have sitting behaviors, adding a touch of realism to their daily lives as they rest or gather around your settlement which are included with this update to reading.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/70a064cd39f89d095bcedc3d561e0b2054c2621c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fishing[/h2]
Fishing will be coming with this update as well. Cast your line in rivers, lakes, or ponds, and reel in a variety of fish to provide another way to sustain your settlement. This feature has been widely requested internally by our team even before our Early Access launch and we’ve been iterating on a bunch of different ways to make it mechanically interesting as well as immersively satisfying. Challenge your friends and see who can angle the biggest catch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/79ff470aa5ccff6fbbde4256826b597fbac8571d.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Decorations[/h2]
You can now personalize your settlements with even more new decorations! These additions let you further customize your town to make it as stunning as possible. We collected a list of what players wanted to see more of when it comes to customization and are adding a variety of new buildable decorations to the crafting nook. Don’t forget to check them out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/afac99d224eafd2addd81c6b87b4a2113c36b561.jpg[/img]

[h2]Check The Preview Branch[/h2]

We’ll be releasing an early iteration of this update in our [url=https://discord.com/channels/1087728082087051376/1243934544512548997]Preview Branch[/url] category on discord very soon. As always, we’re grateful for your support and feedback. It’s your support that allows us to make Bellwright the best it can be.

Until next time,

notes.title: Villages 2.0 Update
notes.content:
Today's update marks a major milestone for the development of Bellwright. Up until now we've been largely focused on stabilization, polish, and adding critical QoL features. With the Autumn Update, we started laying the groundwork for making Bellwright a more dynamic world, where player choice is critical in the success of the Rebellion and future of Karvenia

This Update expands on the idea of rebuilding the Karvenia stone by stone with the help of its liberator - You. With the oppressors gone, it's time to bring prosperity to the villages by expanding them and keeping them secure from unyielding forces of bandits and brigands alike. In turn, the ever-thankful villagers will reward you with access to their growing militia to help on your quest.

[previewyoutube=9jOejfIwzkA;full][/previewyoutube]

After testing and stabilizing on the preview branch for the last several weeks, The Autumn Update is finally here!

One of the most important changes for gameplay introduced in this update is how you interact with villages after liberating them. Now, you have the ability to call militia from the village to your aid, which can be very useful in dealing with stronger enemies.
Villages also have a prosperity level which will affect its population, strength of the militia and possibilities for expanding it. To allow villages to grow stronger you'll need to invest resources into them and protect the area around them against bandits. This goes hand in hand with a reworked bandit migration feature and new strategic map overlays.

Another area that is significantly improved is town customization - buildable roads make your settlement feel more real, help with planning and logistics, while lots of new decorative structures allow you to give your town a unique flavor.

Last but not least, there are plenty of highly requested quality of life improvements - ability to set up structure settings before their construction is finished, fast travel with your companions along the rivers with the help of new River Dock structure, finding location of specific item or structure in your settlement, relocating built structures and much, much more.

This update will be compatible with old saves, but some minor issues may still happen (for example, expect forests cut down before to respawn anew), so just in case you prefer to play on an older version (or keep playing with old mods), we added the option as a separate steam beta branch called the august_update.

notes.title: New Game Feature: Roads and Decorations
notes.content:
With our next big update on the horizon, many of you have been helping us on the preview branch to find bugs and other key issues which help us immensely with getting things up to speed. Today, we wanted to share with you another largely requested feature of the update: Roads and Decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/df8e427dd9e79f3491d6275f5afa3dcb73466eb3.jpg[/img]
With this new change, you’ll be able to build roads within your settlement. These roads will increase movement speed as well as reduce stamina usage when using them. Villagers will prefer these when moving between locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/94b3afe65c3a469ea221844cceaf5b39a29bf334.jpg[/img]
Roads can be built off of the main road and easily connected via snapping points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/6a042556ca3355626809e826f0151bffb5774d10.jpg[/img]
With the new Craftsman’s Nook, you can now make decorative items that are placeable around your settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/402cb40a5f51abaf63fddbbf3c21c6c4011e43d9.jpg[/img]
Chairs can be placed and the interaction direction shows which way they will be facing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/bea858acad4aa280f5f8a496de45788e069c5717.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/b372b0a4ae1de088a7666e051df5c59e83676c7c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/ae98b5255bda11fcf4475372d7cfdd5b7652380a.jpg[/img]

And of course, plenty of new decorations to add some flare and unique aspects to your village including barrels, baskets, shrines stones, and more. We plan to have a lot more decorative options as development continues but we hope you’ll have a lot of fun adding this flavor to your settlement.

notes.title: New Game Feature: Prosperity System
notes.content:
Hi Everyone. We wanted to share just one of the many features we’re working on right now for our next big update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/24c56ac06b5d6fc5ca35a1b59a2c6b7609fa2a8a.jpg[/img]

Internally, we call it Prosperity, but it’s best described as pretty much a full overhaul to how villages interact with each other and adding more life to the world. This next update will introduce a dynamic environment where the safety and control of areas around the map will provide direct benefits to the neighboring towns. We’ve added a few bonuses as well to the upkeep and management of these towns through this system.

This affects many new aspects of what towns provide including
[list]
[*]  Villagers increasing population size + better traits
[*]  Militia recruited as temporary mercenaries
[*]  New town improvements with unique effects
[*]  New trading options for more resources depending on the nearby bandit threat.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/3a9c75468fa5e1ea7e40489a873f7542f805421b.jpg[/img]

With the new village status you can see all the potential villagers for hire, what improvements you’ve added, and the current militia available to help you defend the territory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/f60bff94a62d042e48dfa5f0f0191cc813888bc0.jpg[/img]

VIllage improvements can be used to directly affect the prosperity of that population. In this example, the archery range will add +5 Archers to the pool of militia available for hire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/b285d67b15d4e9600ee565baaa699cfbd7ca26a2.jpg[/img]

The safety of the territory is important and any nearby enemies will contribute to the overall threat level of the adjacent villages.

The more you can protect the villages, the more you will see your prosperity grow, giving further benefits down the line to help in liberating all of Karvenia. We’ve recorded a short video below to help you see all these new systems in action and we’ll make them available to you on our preview branch very soon.

[previewyoutube=BM_wvrWyW70;full]https://youtu.be/BM_wvrWyW70[/previewyoutube]

We have a lot coming in our next big update for Bellwright. This is just one system of many that we’ll be adding along with bugfixes and other improvements. We promise it will be worth the wait!

Until next time,

notes.title: August Update

September is right around the corner, but don't rush turning the calendar page just yet!

August Update brings major balance overhauls of weapons and armors that improve progression and combat feel, and make the long-awaited Gear Presets feature so much more useful when planning your army loadouts, group combat improvements that make soldiers stay in formations, and pages upon pages of other important changes like villager nicknames and block assist.

We've also expanded gameplay settings with options like hunger and food spoilage speed, experience gain, how fast equipment breaks, and other things like damage multipliers. If you're someone who likes to tweak the game to your liking to save time with the grind, give yourself an additional challenge, or just experience the game in a different way, let us know what other setting you'd like to see!

notes.title: Dev Blog: Loud and Clear
notes.content:
Directional melee combat is basically a niche within a niche when it comes to combat systems in games. For better or worse, it’s kind of our thing. And fortunately it feels like the right choice of Bellwright. We believe it adds to the sense of immersion and is a unique element that stands out in our genre. However, we aren’t surprised that it’s somewhat of a divisive issue and even a dealbreaker for a sizable chunk of people who have played Bellwright. First and foremost, we know that the game does a poor job of explaining the mechanics to you, so in this devblog I want to do a couple things. I’m going to try to demystify combat a little. I’ll touch on the basics and try to explain some of the mechanics that aren’t straight forward, like how damage is calculated or how army commands work. And then I’ll talk a bit about our plans for improving both individual and group combat. We’re aware and agree with the even more numerous complaints about things like combat AI, lackluster group combat, combat feeling clunky or slow, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/854980f16e169172d0deed05514ffac8b51cb4f3.gif[/img]

[h1]Combat[/h1]

Let’s get into it. Bellwright uses a directional melee combat system with four attack and block directions, similar to the Mount and Blade series. Placing your cursor in one of the four areas of the screen and pressing LMB (or whatever you have bound to Attack) initiates an attack from that direction. Likewise, holding RMB in a direction blocks incoming attacks from enemies. There are two blocking modes - fluid (default) and non-fluid, which can be toggled in game settings. Non-fluid blocking requires you to press RMB each time you want to block, while fluid blocking allows you to hold RMB and drag it around to intercept incoming attacks from whichever direction they are coming.  If you are using fluid blocking and hold RMB and LMB at the same time, it will lock your block in place, so that you can orient your camera in different directions and move around without your block position changing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/2811b9f157599ec0da64be632f5e9936d2b77ef6.gif[/img]

Holding LMB charges up your attack which increases the damage. Many factors go into the amount of damage you do on a given swing, including the armor and weapon values, the relationship between the type of armor you’re fighting and the weapon type you’re using, the length of your hold, and where in the arch of the swing you make contact. Hitting early or late in your swing will result in reduced damage. 

You can feint by canceling your current attack using RMB and initiating another attack from a different direction. However, if you wait until too far into your swing, you won’t be able to cancel it. This is helpful when you have initiated a swing into a direction that you see an enemy is already blocking. You can feint to try to make them miss their next block.

Lastly, we have a riposte mechanic (commonly referred to as a “chamber” in this genre). To do this, you must attack in the direction from which you are receiving an attack. If you time it correctly, you can both block an incoming attack and initiate your own attack. It can be especially helpful when fighting outnumbered, to regain the initiative when you are under heavy pressure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/f3b4e434cbff391ed239e60aa0df15f890354276.gif[/img]

There are numerous other mechanics that exist out there, many of which we’re excited to try (and maybe even have prototypes for 👀) However, we’re interested to know what you want to see. Keep leaving your feedback, it’s invaluable to us. We’re currently working on enabling the ability for the player to engage in practice fights, with both your villagers and other players in co-op. We understand that mastery of the mechanics is something that can be fun and rewarding, but not when you have to spend 10 minutes running back to pick up your stuff after you die or when you die immediately after starting a fight. In addition, we’re working on improving the Training Groups which will extend the practice fight mechanic and allow your NPCs to passively train their skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/d3ddea8a9bdc8397fd372e2e8075b2d32eb738eb.gif[/img]
[h1]Commanding[/h1]

Right now, when commanding companions in battle, you have a few options on how to control them. They can be targeted to a location (Move) or they can be told to follow you (Follow). In combat, they can be toggled between two modes, Charge and Hold Position.

Charge will tell the companions to attack enemies that aggro them, ignoring their move order. Hold Position tells companions to move to their ordered position and defend that position, ignoring enemies along the way.

So, in order to retreat or reposition your troops, some valid combinations might be to toggle them onto Hold Position and order them to follow or to move to a position away from the threat. 

After combat, you can target a loot bag and your companions will find any lootables within a certain range.

Group combat improvements are going to be one of our major focus areas as we continue stabilizing the game. One of our major goals for the game is to have siege warfare and that can’t be built on the foundation that exists right now. We know that our armies must be much smarter, the player must have much better control over what they’re doing, and group fighting logic needs to be much better. We’ll definitely be exploring things like formations and a more expanded and intuitive commanding menu.

notes.title: Forestry, Staging Ground & Tier 3 Improvements OUT NOW

[h3]After a long month of improvements and bug fixes, Forestry Update - the first of many content updates for Bellwright is finally here![/h3]

Forestry introduces a building where you can grow saplings and use them to replant nearby forests, allowing your settlements to have a sustainable source of wood instead of having to create new outposts deeper and deeper into Karvenia.

Staging Ground is another exciting feature - a gathering place to prepare your companions before journeying further. Companions assigned to it will automatically stock up on food, equipment, and arrows from nearby storages, significantly improving resource management.

Tier 3 buildings received plenty of tweaks and improvements as well. Notably, an overhaul for Windmill and Bakery, with the goal of creating a simple and consistent source of food for all of your workers.

Bakery will now be able to feed every one of your villagers with higher bread output, while Windmill and Thresher will produce significantly more flour and grains. On the other hand, new dishes added to the Inn provide useful status effects for players and soldiers like increased experience gain and higher combat attributes.

Many remaining gameplay issues have also been addressed. For example, many Tier 2 weapons, armors, and some buildings like Drying Rack will no longer require villagers with professions to research them. It was a common complaint that equipment needed to fight the brigands was only unlockable after liberation.

We considered different options like making brigands easier to kill, but ultimately decided that removing profession requirements from some of them would solve the issue without changing the rest of the gameplay.

Additionally, food items that don’t regrow including meat and cooked dishes had their spoilage times increased as many of you have suggested, and Villagers will finally be able to navigate properly around Tier 3 buildings, use ramps and walk on wooden platforms without issues.

notes.title: Dev Blog: A genuine Thank You
notes.content:
Releasing a game to you, the player, is terrifying. Really, genuinely, terrifying. After years of work there is always the fear that you completely missed the mark, or - possibly worse - that you graced the mark but missed anyway. Up to release, there is a constant lingering anxiety that we missed some minor detail that could have been fixed if spotted early enough, but was somehow missed. 

Today, 12 days after release, over 150.000 of you have decided that Bellwright is a game worthy of your time and money, and it’s growing steadily every day. It is hard to explain just how much this means to us. You have taken away the anxiety and replaced it with motivation, encouragement and even trust. We understand what this means, and we will not disappoint you. The message is clear: Bellwright is ambitious and unique, but it’s also early, raw, and needs more work. And work, we will. 

What I am personally thankful for is the community that is forming around the game. No matter where I look - Steam, Discord, Reddit, Twitch - people are friendly, respectful and helping each other out. You are all incredibly pleasant to talk to :)  

One thing you may have noticed is that we have been somewhat reluctant to reveal what is planned for the future. This was a very deliberate decision: We wanted to avoid hyping you up about features that do not exist yet in the game. We feel very strongly that you should only buy Bellwright if you feel it is in a worthy state right now. On the other hand we get asked more and more often to share where we’re headed. There are actually a couple of features in the prototype stage that we could consider previewing. Please give me some advice here, do you prefer us to keep silent about features until they are ready, or would you like us to give you a sneak peek into features we’re working on?

notes.title: Addressing GPU Launch and Crash Issues
notes.content:
We’ve received multiple reports regarding VRAM errors with high-end Nvidia GPUs. Our engineers with the help of the community have pinpointed the issue to a recent report on CPU instability causing  problems such as "stability issues/out of video memory error messages/crash to desktop while the game is compiling shaders" with Intel CPUs of 13th and 14th gen.

We’re inviting you to read the report on this issue here - [url=https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/cpus/nvidia-blames-intel-for-gpu-vram-errors-tells-geforce-gamers-experiencing-13th-or-14th-gen-cpu-instability-to-contact-intel-support]https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/cpus/nvidia-blames-intel-for-gpu-vram-errors-tells-geforce-gamers-experiencing-13th-or-14th-gen-cpu-instability-to-contact-intel-support[/url]

As outlined in the report, Intel is aware of the issue and is currently working on a solution. Contacting Intel Customer Support is preferable in this case, as they should be able to assist in solving it for you. We’ve also reached out to Intel to gather more information on the matter.

For advanced users, you may find steps to solving this issue yourselves in the same report. We must warn you that attempting to fix it personally may be dangerous without sufficient knowledge of modifying BIOS settings.

[h3]Regarding DirectX 12 error[/h3]
Some of you have reported an error that reads [i]“DirectX 12 is not supported on your system”[/i]. We advise you to compare your GPU to the minimum requirements listed on our Steam page, which are NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 8GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB.

notes.title: BELLWRIGHT AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
We invite you to join us in the land of Karvenia, to explore a world of beauty and treachery and uncover the secrets of your past. The release of Bellwright into Early Access marks the end of one long journey, and the beginning of another. We’re honored to share this next step with each and every one of you and can’t wait to see players team up with their friends in co-op, mustering their forces against tyranny, or charging against the crown in singleplayer with the help of their loyal rebels.

[previewyoutube=fTwOZoiz_KU;full][/previewyoutube]

Player feedback has been and will continue to be critical to the successful development of Bellwright. From when you first saw the game at Steam Next Fest, through the recent limited playtest, to today, we’ve managed to significantly improve every aspect of the game. We hope that our work has paid off and that we have provided you with a truly unique experience.

Today, the land of Karvenia offers an expansive map spanning 25km², filled with various regions to explore and settle in, villages to liberate from the oppressive regime, and countless points of interest to visit. You are free to choose any of these locations for the many settlements you will construct on your way to freedom.

To help on your journey to liberation, Bellwright bolsters a smart AI system, where you workers will perform mundane tasks in your towns to sustain the rebellion. Guards will defend your settlements from attacks and keep the peace in your absence, ensuring safety of your people, and companions will aid you on your quest and follow you in battle, where you have the freedom to equip and command your squads in a tactical manner.

When it comes to fighting the hordes of enemies, Bellwright features a skill-based directional combat system, where the outcome of each battle depends solely on you. You can choose directions of your attacks and blocks, use shields and bows, and use your soldiers to your advantage to overcome any dangers that you’ll encounter in Karvenia. Where a single bandit early on may pose a tremendous threat, honing your combat prowess will allow you to slay entire encampments and headquarters as you progress. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805025/5159a0f049bdfa4ea9c74c54233fbf6bb80d2612.png[/img]

The game also offers a substantial story from the main quest in search of the truth of your past to an endless number of sub-quests every step of the way, allowing you to gain trust and renown for completing them, and recruit the people to your cause.

In addition to that, we have already begun work on many of the features we have seen requested,  such as walls and fortifications to withstand against your enemies, road building to pave the way for your follower, and controller support. We’re also currently working on a full fledged Mod Kit to bring your own creations into the world of Bellwright, which is planned to be available very soon after Early Access release.

We believe that from the very first day, Bellwright offers a complete and polished gameplay experience that can be enjoyed both in single player and in co-op with friends. Our release into Early Access provides us with the opportunity to expanded upon and improve what Bellwright already offers, together with you, our community.

We cannot wait to hear of your adventures in the land of Karvenia and would like to invite you all to provide feedback, submit suggestions, and ask questions about the game on our Discord, where our developers frequently participate in conversations.

notes.title: Forge Your Destiny in 'Bellwright'
notes.content:
Embark on an epic journey of rebellion and liberation in our thrilling new action-packed RPG, 'Bellwright'!

We’re excited to provide newcomers some insight into our new title that seamlessly blends gameplay elements reminiscent of instant classics like Bannerlord, Rimworld, Valheim and more. Set in the medieval era, 'Bellwright' weaves a tale of betrayal, resilience, and the fight for freedom.

[previewyoutube=DInawaGvJMo;full][/previewyoutube]

Your character, scarred by a history of betrayal, returns to the lowlands with a mission—to rally a rebellion and free the people from the grip of a tyrant. The core mechanics revolve around crafting and building various structures to raise a settlement from nothing. Your villagers will require housing, food, and protection! Utilize the building mechanics to provide cabins, foraging huts, and walls to stave off the perils around you. This game doesn’t pull any punches - efficient resource management and the strategic development of equipment are crucial in overcoming the political turmoil that plagues the land. Equip your units with different armor types and tools, along with an assortment of weaponry to further customize and optimize your army and settlement.

Every character and NPC in our game has their own unique attributes and specializations. You can recruit a level 1 villager and train them up to be a worthwhile soldier, or work to recruit an already well established knight to your cause. Bellwright also employs a fun but challenging directional combat, similar to games like Mount & Blade or For Honor. This makes combat engaging and skill-based, with every bout a unique encounter requiring the correct positioning and timing. Your skills will be put to the test as you engage in combat with the various brigands and bandits surrounding the lowlands. Many have set up camp, and the difficulty scales as the dynamic population escalates as you progress further through the game.

For enthusiasts of narrative depth, our game unfolds in an immersive world filled with voiced NPCs, each with unique towns, professions, and backstories! Dive into hundreds of rewarding quests that unveil the rich lore within the region.

Craft, build, trade, fight, or explore—'Bellwright' encapsulates the essence of a traditional medieval RPG. Play as a solo or raise a rebellion in co-op with your friends. By equipping the right gear, constructing a thriving settlement, and defending against the looming threats, you can ensure the land will prosper once again under your leadership as the Bellwright!

notes.title: Thank you for playing Bellwright Demo!
notes.content:
[b]Thank you to everyone that tried out our Bellwright demo during Next Fest![/b]

It was an exciting week for our team, especially seeing just how many of you decided to try our demo. We were blown away to learn that Bellwright ended up being the 4th on the list of Daily Active Demo Players on the Fest (shoutout to Warhaven, Lies of P, and Norland!), and we can’t wait for you to see more!

We’re still going through all of your feedback and encourage anyone who has more to say to please leave it for us to read on the forums! We’d love to hear what else you’d like to see in the game, what you particularly did or did not enjoy, and any kind of suggestions you might have.

Getting to watch your streams and videos was very special to us, as it's our first time seeing anyone outside the dev team walk through Karvenia, and we especially appreciate everyone that took the time to share their thoughts on the game while playing. Special shoutout to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/tkm_ferdnand]tkm_Ferdnand[/url] for spending almost 3 in-game months in the Lowlands, while building the absolute biggest camp we’ve ever seen and ending up with such a massive army that poor brigands were squirming when it marched.

There’s quite a bit of work ahead of us, and plenty of things to add, improve, and fix. Truth be told, we hadn’t initially planned on making a demo before the release, so the version of the game you’ve played was more of a spontaneous beta test than an extremely polished slice of the full game. It goes without saying that you should expect huge improvements in every aspect of the game by the time Bellwright is out, including general stability, variety of localization options, professional voice over, intuitive UI, and improved performance to name a few things you've mentioned.

There’s also a massive amount of content you haven’t seen yet that we’re working on for release: full-fledged warfare and rebellion, allowing you to march your armies against the oppressive kingdom, liberating villages and protecting your territories by building fortified town defenses or even whole fortresses, new massive regions with their own unique looks and feel, full of exciting places to explore and fight over, town progression going all the way from a small camp to a prosperous medieval city, and much more. Not to mention all the ideas we’ve collected so far from your feedback that we’ve already discussed and planned out.

It’s been wonderful to see so many of you enjoy the game, even in such an early state that it’s in. We can’t wait to share more about our plans with you, so if you'd like to stay up to date with the news about Bellwright, make sure to wishlist and keep an eye on the Steam announcements for what’s coming next!

notes.title: Bellwright - Developer Stream
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome to the Bellwright Demo[/h3]

[i]Establish and expand your own settlements, liberate the land and assist its villagers, and recruit others to your cause while learning more about a life you had to leave behind. Command your forces, prove your valor through combat, and cement yourself as the hero of your people.[/i]


[b]Bellwright Demo[/b] features the beginning of the hero's story, just as you return to your homeland, where your journey starts. Establish and grow your own village, help others and recruit them to your cause, command your army and fight in epic battles. All of this and much more is available in the demo, where you're free to explore an entire region of the kingdom of Karvenia, discovering countless quests, enemies, treasures, and other secrets within it.

You’ve come to the region of Lowlands with a goal in mind, but the people consider you an outsider, and you have to earn their trust before they’re willing to help you with information, assistance, or both. With a camp set up and next to nothing to your name, you’ll venture out and soon find yourself developing and strengthening relationships with villages and their inhabitants by helping them with various tasks and defeating bandits that plague the land. 

As you establish yourself as a trustworthy figure among the people of the Lowlands, you’ll be able to grow your camp into a village of your own and manage your settlers and the resources they’ve gathered. Engage in combat solo or with a few of your settlers to take on enemies that have taken up residence in the Lowlands, eventually building up strength and numbers to have your own army to command.



[b]The demo will be available during the Steam Next Fest from June 19th to June 26th.[/b]


We'd love to hear what you think about our demo, as we continue to tirelessly work on Bellwright.

Make sure to wishlist to get the news on the game and be the first to hear when we announce the release date and other exciting events!
